equities.source: Yahoo chart API, split-adjusted OHLC, adjclose separate

hypotheses.mechanism: equity returns have historically been weaker in high-implied-vol regimes; the premium is paid by hedgers who buy protection

hypotheses.reason: no historical point-in-time announcement timestamps aligned to prices
no historical funding, basis, or executable order-book data

frozen.rules: Long SPY only when the prior completed VIX close is below its own 20-session average. Otherwise cash. Fill SPY at the next open. VIX is a signal only, never a fill. No shorting.
frozen.fail: Reject unless validation beats SPY buy-and-hold after costs, has at least 8 trades, and positive net.

multipleTesting: Ten prior rejected tests plus this one. A single validation window is not statistical proof.
